name: app-shell-crawler-control
title: Capture console · icon rail, capture queue tabs and expandable run feeds
description: Capture console · icon rail, capture queue tabs and expandable run feeds. Blocks/App Shell pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/blocks/AppShell and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in block built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:g-udi/design-system. Demo assets referenced (supply your own or copy them into public/): /avatars/person-23.svg, /avatars/person-41.svg, /avatars/person-50.svg.
